purpose: Specify an internal adapter above the unchanged public database loader. Recover only DB selection, decoded-array interpretation, editable-state population and its lifecycle.

activities: Read retained native pseudocode and selected existing dossiers, source APIs, schema, comparisons and capture manifests.
Inspected import-snapshot records and the 625-record fstres-static-evidence bundle for specific missing bodies.
Read existing cpp-step25 decoded integer bytes to corroborate address-table/count formulas.
method.interpretation: static_fact means a retained decompiler body establishes a path; it does not mean execution was observed. runtime_observation is bounded to the recorded two imports. fixture_corroboration is an offline reading of retained decoded bytes. proposed_design and unresolved are not original behavior.
method.search_boundary: Matching top-level evidence filenames plus procedure_pseudo_code/analyze_function records in oracle/import-snapshot.json and oracle/fstres-static-evidence.json. Other archives were not exhaustively searched; absent here is not proof absent everywhere.
method.scope: Complete main-array 3D version11000 is the immediately usable layout. Some 2D/header/legacy branches are documented statically but do not authorize a complete adapter for them.
method.preservation: Only Chat C analysis deliverables are written. No production code, shared model headers, central ledger, Git settings, merges, pushes, builds, shared REA session access or original runtime launches.

established_loader_boundary.existing: database owns a path and file/header/step metadata. load_step returns independent owned vectors; it does not mutate an ObjectModel. summarize_objects is a separate bounded consumer.
disk_contract: 512-byte physical records, big-endian int32 and float64, 64-bit file offsets, linked root/page step tables; every 13-word row is retained.
Unified database dimension23 chooses row.words[7]/[8] as effective step dimension/version; legacy rows use file-header dimension/version.
find_step(number) returns the first matching signed step number; record indices can disambiguate duplicates. stored_steps uses words[3]>0; has_arrays requires both words[3]>0 and words[4]>0.
Header is read from physical record words[10] with words[2] float64 words. Older direct-array paths read words[11]/[12] using words[3]/[4]; modern 3D paths interpret these as int32 block directories.

Modern header[6]/[7] give decoded array sizes using nonnegative nearest-integer conversion floor(x+0.5) in the existing loader. Native application allocation instead truncates and substitutes 2000000 for both sizes if either is zero; do not change the loader to imitate that allocation policy.
Each modern block has logical_capacity, one-based destination, stored_count and physical record; packed values are expanded into their destination. Raw directory words survive.
load_auxiliary is separate. Version<11000 or row.words[9]==0 returns present=false. Otherwise 20 metadata words, ten-word descriptors and packed integer/real payloads are retained.
Physical decoding and compression do not assign editable model semantics. The adapter must not confuse block directories with I/R semantic address tables embedded at the start of M.

public_api_preserved: No changes to include/deform/database.hpp, packed_array.hpp or object_summary.hpp.

internal_seams: Read/inspect layer accepts const loaded_step plus explicit record_index, source identity and optional separately loaded auxiliary_data. Produce an owned or lifetime-bounded DB import plan with exact source index/byte provenance.

Application layer executes a proven stage sequence against ObjectModel. Require a complete mapping profile before claiming complete editable-state import; summary-only or partial plans must identify missing domains.
Own copied model arrays; borrowed source spans may exist only during inspection/application and must not escape.

Full compatibility wrapper must address clear-before-I/O behavior. Predecoding everything then swapping a completed model would preserve old state on errors, unlike the observed coordinator. Either stage I/O/application faithfully or explicitly label such a transactional mode as an extension.

Existing KEY setters can refresh layouts or remap fields at different points. find_or_create_material and apply_relation_mode are not proved substitutes for DB readers.
ObjectRecord lacks explicit DB mesh-presence/range metadata, many native subobjects, full geometry-container family and inter-object interaction storage.
SimulationControls represents a selected subset; DB title, operation metadata, unit selector and much of1eb870 are absent or unbound.
Existing MaterialRecord/RelationRecord storage does not establish DB identifier/table/reference decoding. root material/relation counts are separate from list ownership.
Dynamic metadata and auxiliary entries need an ID/tag/owner mapping before reaching CustomFields or DynamicArrays.
